title: Apple Made Its FIRST Touchscreen Mac. Worth $2,899? 🤔
description:
Apple just made its first Mac you can touch — and it's got a brand-new two-layer OLED screen.

The MacBook Pro with PROLED XDR Display (14- and 16-inch, M5 Pro / M5 Max) went on sale on 6 November 2026 from $2,899. We explain how tandem OLED works, check Apple's 2,000-nit and 24-hour claims against Notebookcheck and Macworld lab tests, look at what iFixit found inside (5/10), and score it with our Spec or Wreck benchmark.

By our score: 66.5/100 → SPEC, if you edit photos or video or watch a lot of HDR. Just want a fast Mac? The M6 14-inch MacBook Pro starts at $1,999.
